failure.stage: post-MD5/SHA archive verification, before receipt serialization and before waveform-array access
failure.exception: ValueError: relative final_path cannot be made relative_to absolute workspace ROOT
failure.root_cause: The frozen downloader accepts a relative --destination but constructs a relative final path, then calls final_path.relative_to(ROOT).

required_recovery.fix: Resolve and constrain CLI paths to the workspace before producing receipt-relative paths.
required_recovery.restart_policy: Re-verify all archives under the successor receipt before any waveform-array access; no v2 result may be recovered or reused.
